workflows.description: Multi-step API workflows where Step 1 generates/extracts data and Step 2 creates the entity using that data
workflows.dataPassthrough: CRITICAL: The response from Step 1 contains ALL the structured data needed for Step 2. When user confirms, pass the COMPLETE Step 1 response as the request body for Step 2. Do NOT construct a new empty request - reuse the extracted data.

patterns.name: Opportunity Creation from Documents

step1.purpose: Analyzes documents using AI and returns structured proposal data
step1.returns: Complete proposal object with: name, description, deliverables, countries, sdGs, fundingPartners, clientPartners, stakeholders, targetSigningDate, targetDeliveryDate, initiativeBudgetUSD, strategicAlignment, resultsFocus, expectedImpact, expectedOutcomes, expectedBeneficiaries, challenges, documents

step2.purpose: Creates the opportunity record in the system
step2.receives: The SAME data object returned by Step 1 - pass through all fields without modification

patterns.userConfirmation: After Step 1, show results to user. When they confirm (yes/create/proceed/go ahead), call Step 2 with Step 1's response data

apiEndpoints.description: SIMPLE TEXT SEARCH: Use for quick keyword searches across contact name, email, title, and basic text fields. Supports fuzzy matching and typo correction. Example queries: 'Find John Smith', 'Search for contacts with email containing unicef', 'Look up program managers'. Do NOT use for partner relationship filtering, department filtering with specific values, or date-based searches - use advanced-search instead.

apiEndpoints.whenNotToUse: Do NOT use when user needs to filter by specific partner organization, department with exact match, dates, or multiple criteria combinations

SEMANTIC AI-POWERED SEARCH: Performs semantic search on interactions using AI embeddings to find conceptually similar interactions based on natural language queries. Unlike regular search which matches keywords, this finds interactions with similar meaning/context. Use this when user wants to find interactions by concept, topic, or semantic similarity rather than exact keywords.
apiEndpoints.whenToUse: Use when user says: 'find interactions similar to X', 'find meetings about topic X', 'search for emails related to concept X', 'find interactions like X'. Also use when regular search doesn't find good matches and user needs conceptual/semantic matching.
apiEndpoints.whenNotToUse: Do NOT use for simple keyword searches or when user wants exact text matches - use /search instead

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Natural language search query. Can be a phrase, sentence, or description of what you're looking for. The AI will find interactions with similar meaning/context.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Similarity threshold between 0.0 and 1.0. Higher values return only very similar results, lower values return more results with looser matching. (default: 0.7)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return, between 1 and 100. (default: 10)

apiEndpoints.description: SIMPLE TEXT SEARCH: Use for quick keyword searches across opportunity name, description, and basic text fields. Supports fuzzy matching and typo correction. Use this when user asks to 'find', 'search for', or 'look up' opportunities by name or topic. Example queries: 'Find opportunities about water infrastructure', 'Search for climate projects', 'Look up healthcare initiatives'. Do NOT use for workflow stage filtering, partner filtering, date ranges, or complex criteria - use advanced-search instead.
apiEndpoints.whenToUse: Use for simple name/description keyword searches. User says: 'find opportunities about X', 'search for X opportunities', 'look up projects with keyword X'
apiEndpoints.whenNotToUse: Do NOT use when user needs to filter by workflow stage, specific partners (funding/client), org unit, initiative type, dates, SDGs, or multiple criteria combinations

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search text/keywords to find in opportunity name and description fields. Supports partial matches and fuzzy matching.

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Sort direction - true for oldest first, false for newest first (default: false for most recent)

parameters.name: export
parameters.description: Whether to export all results without pagination (default: false)

parameters.name: filterActive
parameters.description: Whether to filter only active opportunities (default: true)

apiEndpoints.description: STRUCTURED CRITERIA SEARCH: Use for complex searches with specific field filters, workflow stage, partner relationships, org unit, initiative type, dates, SDGs, or multiple criteria combinations. REQUIRED when user wants to filter by: workflow stage (Prospecting/Pipeline/Negotiation/Won/Lost), specific funding or client partner, responsible org unit, initiative type, target dates, implementation countries, SDGs, or any combination of criteria. Example queries: 'Find opportunities in Pipeline stage', 'Show opportunities with UNICEF as funding partner', 'Get opportunities targeting 2024', 'Find healthcare opportunities in Africa'.
apiEndpoints.whenToUse: Use when user needs: workflow stage filtering, partner filtering (funding/client), org unit filtering, initiative type, date ranges, country filtering, SDG alignment, or ANY combination of multiple criteria
apiEndpoints.whenNotToUse: Do NOT use for simple name/description keyword searches where only text matching is needed - use /search instead
